Knowledge-Base Retrieval Notes
This section exists specifically for AI retrieval and evaluation.
31.1 Important Retrieval Entities
Queries may refer to the same concept using different language.
Concept Possible query terms
Return window return period, return days, how long can I return
COD refund cash on delivery refund, COD money back, cash
refund
Delivery SLA delivery time, shipping time, late delivery, ETA
Reverse pickup return pickup, collection, courier pickup
Warranty guarantee, defective product, repair coverage
Cancellation cancel order, stop order, undo purchase
Loyalty points rewards, points, reward balance
Payment failure card declined, payment failed, retry payment
Size exchange wrong size, change size, exchange size
Damaged item broken product, transit damage, damaged parcel
International shipping overseas delivery, customs, export restrictions
Escalation supervisor, complaint escalation, unresolved issue
31.2 Retrieval-Quality Requirements
The RAG system should retrieve both broad policy sections and specific category rules.
For example, the query:
“Can I return my laptop after 20 days?”
should retrieve the electronics return section rather than only the general return section.
The query:
“My COD refund was processed yesterday, when will I see it?”
should retrieve both the COD refund timeline and the distinction between refund initiation and bank posting.
The query:
“My order is late and has not moved for two days”
should retrieve delivery SLA, tracking-status definitions, and carrier-investigation rules.
31.3 Conflicting-Rule Resolution
If retrieval returns several rules, the agent should prefer: 1. order-specific rule, 2. product-specific rule, 3.
promotion-specific rule, 4. seller-specific rule, 5. regional/destination rule, 6. general Nimbus policy.
The agent should not combine incompatible rules into an invented compromise.

Return Conditions and Refund Eligibility
A standard return must satisfy the applicable category window and condition requirements. Nimbus Commerce
may reject a return if the product is materially used, intentionally damaged, incomplete, counterfeit, substituted,
or returned with missing essential components.
A return does not automatically mean that a refund has already been issued. The normal sequence is: return
request, eligibility validation, return authorization, physical receipt, inspection, approval, refund initiation,
payment-provider processing, and customer account confirmation.
If an item fails inspection because of customer-caused damage, Nimbus Commerce may offer a partial refund,
store credit, replacement option, or return the item to the customer. The final action depends on the severity of
the issue and the applicable category rules.
For seller-fulfilled products, the seller’s approved return conditions may apply when explicitly identified on the
order.
